_about: Every shipped code line naming a PowerShell program is fingerprinted. Direct launches remain prohibited except the exact user-terminal entry. The additional command-environment probe in engine-env.ts uses execCli, a fixed nonce-tagged script, a pinned NoProfile form, closed stdin, a hidden console, bounded output and bounded cleanup. No command text or environment value is interpolated into that script.
